properties.evidence: alignment: this WEAKENS one of that brainstorm's arguments rather than opposing the idea. The node lists RocksDB's disk footprint as an uncontested cost of keeping it (one cached librocksdb-sys dir at 1.7 GB). Measured here, RocksDB's artifact is 856 MB against 263 GiB of reflow2's own duplicated test binaries — 0.3% of the problem. A backend swap would not have prevented this failure, so the disk argument should not carry weight in that decision.
